must_contain: Halcyon Harbor Hotels, Inc., Internal Audit Department, final report issued June 18, 2031
Internal Audit reviewed how front desk cash is received, counted, stored and deposited at three hotels during the first quarter of 2031.
Overall rating: Needs improvement. Two of the six findings are rated high.
Management agreed with every finding and has set target dates for all corrective actions, the last of them in November 2031.
The audit covered the following procedures at each hotel:
Opening and closing counts of each cash drawer
Access to the back office safe and its key log
Preparation and timeliness of bank deposits
Reconciliation of deposits to the property management system
The detailed test steps are described in the Audit IA-2031-07 test plan, which is available to hotel controllers.
Each finding is rated using the scale in Table 1.
Table 2. Findings and management responses

Blind counts were not performed at the Seattle Waterfront hotel.
Late deposits exceeded the target of 5 percent of all deposits.
Management response: we accept the findings and will report progress to the Audit Committee every quarter until all actions are closed.

rows:
Blind counts not performed
At two hotels the closing clerk saw the expected drawer balance before counting.

Remove the expected balance from the closing screen
Train all clerks on blind counts by August 15

Safe key log incomplete
The key log for the back office safe had no entries for 9 of 90 days tested.
A daily sign-off of the key log has been added to the night audit checklist.

Change fund over the approved limit
The Portland Pearl change fund held $2,400 against an approved limit of $1,500.
The excess was deposited on April 2 and the limit was confirmed in writing.

Late bank deposits
Deposits were made more than one business day after receipt in 23 of 156 cases.

Use the armored car pickup on Saturdays
Report late deposits weekly to the area controller

Unexplained variances
Variances above $50 were cleared without a written explanation in 7 cases.
Variances above $25 now require a written explanation signed by the controller.

Duplicate deposit slip numbers
The same slip number was used twice at Tacoma Narrows in February.
Numbered deposit slip books are now issued by the area office.
